note: Capability facts checked against official developer docs on the date above. Re-verify at implementation time; do not trust old blogs/repos. publishing_status uses the SUPPORTED/AUTH_REQUIRED/APP_REVIEW_REQUIRED/ACCOUNT_TYPE_REQUIRED/LIMITED/MANUAL_ONLY/NOT_SUPPORTED/UNKNOWN vocabulary.

platforms.official_api: YouTube Data API v3 (videos.insert, resumable upload)
platforms.account_requirement: Google account with a YouTube channel
platforms.known_limits: videos.insert = 100 uploads/day (own quota bucket). Unverified API projects created after 2020-07-28 upload as PRIVATE until an API audit. Shorts vs long-form share this infra; validation profile differs.
platforms.implementation_decision: Implement YouTubePublisher on Data API v3 + resumable upload; expose audit/verification state in Account Health; long-form and Shorts share infra, separate ContentValidation profiles.

platforms.official_api: TikTok Content Posting API (video.publish direct post / video.upload inbox)
platforms.account_requirement: User must authorize video.publish; unaudited clients post PRIVATE only
platforms.known_limits: Direct Post (video.publish) requires an app audit (~1-4 weeks). video.upload path lands in the user's inbox for MANUAL confirmation. Query Creator Info for allowed privacy/comment/duet/stitch/max-duration before posting.
platforms.implementation_decision: Implement TikTokPublisher for both flows; default to video.upload (WAITING_USER_ACTION) until the app is audited; never force unsupported privacy/interaction options; never bypass the user consent flow.

platforms.official_api: Instagram Platform Content Publishing API (media container -> media_publish)
platforms.account_requirement: Instagram Professional (Business/Creator) account; for the Facebook-login path also a linked Facebook Page + Business
platforms.known_limits: 100 API-published posts / rolling 24h (carousel counts as 1). Reels: 9:16, 5-90s, H.264/HEVC. Carousel = create child containers, wait FINISHED, then parent publish. Media served from a public URL.
platforms.implementation_decision: Implement InstagramPublisher on the container flow via shared MetaClient; carousel = all children FINISHED or abort parent; publish only after status FINISHED; verify permalink.

platforms.official_api: Facebook Graph API - Page feed / Page Video / Reels
platforms.account_requirement: Facebook Page (admin) - publishes as the Page, not a personal profile
platforms.known_limits: Personal-profile publishing is not available via API. Reels have their own upload/processing endpoints. App Review for pages_manage_posts.
platforms.implementation_decision: Implement FacebookPublisher on Page endpoints via shared MetaClient; publisher logic separate from Instagram.

platforms.account_requirement: Threads account; Tech Provider Verification for the app
platforms.known_limits: 250 posts / 24h. No batch thread endpoint - chain posts sequentially via reply_to_id, waiting for each previous id. Video up to 5 min. Carousel up to 10 items.
platforms.implementation_decision: Implement ThreadsPublisher on the container flow; multi-post threads = root publish then reply chain, storing every remote id; use the Phase 1-B native Threads content object, not the IG caption.

platforms.official_api: X API v2 (POST /2/tweets, media upload v2)
platforms.account_requirement: X developer account; paid API access
platforms.known_limits: Free tier discontinued. Pay-per-use is the current default for new devs (approx $0.015 per post created, higher with a link); legacy Basic/Pro monthly tiers exist for existing subscribers. Pricing is volatile -> store as config, mark PRICING_UNKNOWN if unverified. Thread = reply chain via in_reply_to_tweet_id.
platforms.implementation_decision: Implement XPublisher for post/reply/thread + media; record API access level + per-post cost in provider capability + cost log; do NOT invent a price.

platforms.account_requirement: Pinterest account; new apps start in TRIAL access (owner account only, heavy rate limits) until upgraded to STANDARD
platforms.known_limits: Every pin needs a board_id. Video pins are a multi-step upload via /v5/media then reference the media_id. Trial access is owner-only.
platforms.implementation_decision: Implement PinterestPublisher on v5; require board selection; video = register media then create pin; surface TRIAL vs STANDARD in Account Health; use Phase 1-B Pinterest-native asset.

platforms.official_api: LinkedIn Posts API (part of Community Management API)
platforms.account_requirement: Verified LinkedIn app with the 'Share on LinkedIn' product for member posts; organization posting needs the Community Management API (registered company + verified Page + two-tier partner review).
platforms.known_limits: r_member_social is closed to new access. Documents are a distinct media type. Personal (w_member_social) vs Organization (w_organization_social) differ in scope and review.
platforms.implementation_decision: Implement LinkedInPublisher for text/image/video/document; report AUTH_REQUIRED (member) or APP_REVIEW_REQUIRED (organization) accurately in Account Health.

platforms.official_api: None verified. Naver Login Open API historically exposed a blog write endpoint; current availability UNKNOWN.
platforms.auth: OAuth 2.0 (Naver) - if the write API is available
platforms.known_limits: No fake publisher. Produce a NAVER_BLOG_PACKAGE (title, HTML/Markdown article, images + placements, tags, sources, metadata) for manual posting. If an official write API is confirmed at implementation time, add an adapter behind a flag.
platforms.implementation_decision: NaverBlogPublisher returns status MANUAL_ONLY and emits a publish package; browser assist stays behind NAVER_BROWSER_ASSIST=false and never bypasses CAPTCHA / identity / security verification (-> WAITING_USER_ACTION).

platforms.official_api: None. Naver Clip upload is mobile-app only; no verified public publishing API.
platforms.known_limits: No automated publish. Keep the Phase 1-B vertical video + emit a manual-upload package.
platforms.implementation_decision: NaverClipPublisher returns NOT_SUPPORTED for auto-publish; provides a manual-upload package; re-verify official API at implementation time.
